_comment: How each jurisdiction declares the FRONT of a multi-street lot. Keyed by Zoneomics city_id. front_rule values: shortest_frontage | address_street | designated | owner_elected | all_fronts. source: 'code' = found in the municipal code (see citation), 'default' = code silent; the front then defaults to the street named in the parcel's situs address (address_street), falling back to shortest frontage when no street edge matches the address. Consumed by edge-labeling.ts via the frontRule input.

295.citation: PAMC 18.09.040(j)(4) corner-lot election (10 ft street side / 16 ft front)

359.citation: SMC 19.34 / 19.79.070 - corner lots have two front yards; longer frontage reducible to ~9 ft

148.citation: SJMC 20.30.210(A) - oversized corner lots deemed two front property lines

3892.citation: HMC 17.24.020(A) - 25 ft street-line setback on every street frontage; no front concept

2653.citation: LMC 6-566(b)(2) - principal frontage per district; secondary frontage 4 ft for Class C ADUs

3985.citation: MMC 8.68.090 - front lot line = principal street

3361.citation: OMC 17.4.8 - shorter frontage is generally the front

1498.citation: TC 17.040.020(D) - 10 ft on every street frontage of a corner lot

1508.citation: MMC 20.90.030(A)(12) - primary frontage by driveway/home orientation; remaining street frontage is the side yard

1526.citation: SMC 10.88 - owner elects the front street line with Director concurrence

1933.citation: NMC 17.06.030 - on a corner lot the front line is the shorter of any two adjacent street lot lines

1485.citation: AMC 17.52.040(F)(7) - front designated by the address street on corner/double-frontage lots

1507.citation: MPMC 16.04.405 - owner may elect the front lot line on corner lots

1515.citation: PVMC 18.04.350 - owner may elect any street parcel line as front, with town planner concurrence; flag lots: line nearest and most nearly parallel to the street

1520.citation: SCMC 18.41.020 - corner lot front = the shorter lot line abutting a street; flag lots: interior line nearest and most parallel to the access street

1522.citation: SMMC 27.04.300(a) - on a corner lot the owner may elect either street property line as the front; through lots: both street lines are fronts (27.04.275(d))

3893.citation: County zoning Def. 80 - front lot line = the narrowest lot frontage

1505.citation: LAMC 14.02.010 Lot line - corner lot front = shortest dimension fronting the street; either line allowed only if both remain conforming; flag lots: interior line nearest and most parallel to the access street

8903.citation: LAHMC 10-1.505(c)(2) - Planning Commission designates the 40-ft street on multi-street lots

296.citation: MVCC 36.60.27 - corner lot front = shortest frontage unless the owner designates the longer at time of development; through lots: both lines are fronts

1525.citation: SMC 15-06.430(a) - corner lot front = shortest dimension fronting the street; flag lots: interior line nearest the access street; Director assigns lines on irregular lots

6095.citation: HMC 20.28.310 - front = line separating the narrower street frontage of a corner lot from a street (verified from Nov 2024 archive; live eCode360 gated)

6101.citation: Zoning Ord. 27.60.020 - corner-lot front = shortest frontage (Director decides ties); through lots: both street lines are fronts; flag-lot front setback Director-determined (27.20.070(C)(1))
